target.statement: CavMerge achieves average ARI = 0.990 on the Aggregation 2D dataset (Table 1, 100 random trials)

compute.basis: No code link in the PDF (supplemental R package referenced but not linked); the algorithm is simple point-counting plus K-means over K=1..Kmax with 25 starts, so reimplementation is feasible but the exact K-means/jump-statistic pipeline and 100-seed protocol must be rebuilt from scratch.

blockers: No code repository linked in the PDF; supplemental R package not accessible from the text
Simulated 2D datasets (e.g., Aggregation) must be regenerated or sourced from prior papers (Almodóvar-Rivera & Maitra 2020; Peterson et al. 2018)
Exact reproduction of the 0.990 ARI requires matching the jump-statistic K selection and 25 random starts
title: CavMerge: Merging K-means Based on Local Log-Concavity
